entities.name: glutamatergic EPSCs in dorsal horn neurons

relationships.subject: spinal nerve ligation
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunoblotting assays showed that compared with that in sham rats, the protein level of CB2 in the DRG was significantly increased in spinal nerve ligation (SNL) rats at day 10

relationships.subject: JWH-133
relationships.object: glutamatergic EPSCs in dorsal horn neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: in SNL rats, bath application of 10 to 50 μM of JWH-133 significantly reduced the amplitude of evoked monosynaptic EPSCs of lamina II neurons in a concentration-dependent manner

relationships.subject: JWH-133
relationships.evidence_quote: In SNL rats, intrathecal administration of 50 and 100 μg, but not 10 or 20 μg, of JWH-133 significantly attenuated tactile allodynia, mechanical hyperalgesia, and heat hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: spinal nerve ligation
relationships.evidence_quote: the enrichment of H3K4me3 across all four regions at the Cnr2 promoter was significantly increased in in the DRG of SNL rats compared with that in sham control rats

relationships.subject: spinal nerve ligation
relationships.evidence_quote: nerve injury significantly reduced the enrichment of H3K27me3 across all four regions at the Cnr2 promoter

key_findings: Nerve injury raises CB2 in DRG neurons and spinal terminals via increased H3K4me3/H3K9ac and decreased H3K9me2/H3K27me3 at the Cnr2 promoter, without DNA methylation change.
CB2 agonist JWH-133 reduces dorsal root-evoked EPSCs and pain hypersensitivity only in nerve-injured rats.
